items.title: Western Digital Stock Gets A Lift From AI Storage Demand
items.summary: Western Digital recently entered a new US$1,500 million senior unsecured five-year revolving credit facility maturing in 2031, while the prior 2022 loan agreement was terminated and all outstanding amounts repaid.
